tasks.label: Write artifact info
args: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$a='C:\Users\user\Desktop\Regaarder-Pwin\Regaarder-Project-main\Regaarder-4.0-main\android\app\build\outputs\bundle\prodRelease\app-prod-release.aab'; $b='C:\Users\user\Desktop\Regaarder-Pwin\Regaarder-Project-main\Regaarder-4.0-main\android\app\build\outputs\apk\prod\release\app-prod-release.apk'; Get-Item $a,$b | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-List | Out-File -FilePath C:\Users\user\Desktop\Regaarder-Pwin\artifact-info.txt -Encoding utf8"

tasks.label: Compute APK hash visibility fix
args: $src='C:\Users\user\Desktop\Regaarder-Pwin\Regaarder-Project-main\Regaarder-4.0-main\android\app\build\outputs\apk\prod\release\app-prod-release.apk'; if (!(Test-Path $src)) { Write-Output 'SRC_MISSING'; exit 1 }; $ts=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $dst="$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\app-prod-release-visibility-fix-$ts.apk"; Copy-Item $src $dst -Force; $hash=(Get-FileHash $dst -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; $item=Get-Item $dst; Write-Output "APK=$($item.FullName)"; Write-Output "SIZE_MB=$([math]::Round($item.Length/1MB,2))"; Write-Output "SHA256=$hash"; Write-Output "MTIME=$($item.LastWriteTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'))"

tasks.label: Copy APK to Downloads (fixed)
args: $src='C:\Users\user\Desktop\Regaarder-Pwin\Regaarder-Project-main\Regaarder-4.0-main\android\app\build\outputs\apk\prod\release\app-prod-release.apk'; if (!(Test-Path $src)) { Write-Output 'SRC_MISSING'; exit 1 }; $ts=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $dst=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ('Downloads\app-prod-release-visibility-fix-' + $ts + '.apk'); Copy-Item $src $dst -Force; $hash=(Get-FileHash $dst -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; $item=Get-Item $dst; Write-Output ('APK=' + $item.FullName); Write-Output ('SIZE_MB=' + [math]::Round($item.Length/1MB,2)); Write-Output ('SHA256=' + $hash); Write-Output ('MTIME=' + $item.LastWriteTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'))
